correctness.rationale: Exact signed augmented 10012-face integral chain complex; 5002 unimodular chain contractions give 6 degree-four and 2 degree-five generators and zero residual differential. Inclusion/projection checked, exact eight-element D4 maps satisfy group relations and traces (6,2,2,0,-2), (2,-2,0,0,0). Independent fixed-simplex Lefschetz values agree. Character inner products and characteristic-zero transfer prove decomposition and rational quotient.
